prompt: Fix the Python implementation in solution.py. Repair subtract_occurrences(items, removals): return a new shallow list initially containing items, then process removals in order. For each removal delete only the first equality-matching item still present; an absent value has no effect. Preserve the relative order of remaining objects, support unhashable elements, and never mutate either input list. Make the edit, check the behavior, and complete the task. /no_think
initial_solution:
def subtract_occurrences(items, removals):
    return [x for x in items if x not in removals]
